title: Rate limits and unfunded providers must not fail a mission
goal: A live engine mission failed for two reasons that are not task failures. (1) SiliconFlow answered a provider-side 429 on turn 24 with no Retry-After; the worker's paced resends only cover the gateway's pacing, so the attempt died. (2) Escalation then picked claude-sonnet, whose provider has no credit (0 tokens, no_credit), so the fixer tier was silently empty while the budget report still called anthropic active. (3) A cooling or unfunded model is answered HTTP 400 by the gateway, which the adapter reports as a bare turn failure and hides the cause. Rate limits must cool the model for a window and escalate instead of failing the mission; an unfunded provider must be recorded and never lead or fix; a model that cannot serve must answer a retryable 429 with Retry-After, never 400.
